text:
hana: quick idea 1: Make a minimal DP checklist (one pager) that fits in an email. current threads get too long.
liam: yes pls. we need recruiter-friendly copy + clear "what we need from you" bullets.
noor: propose sections: intake + initial score, what partner provides, what we deliver, quick launch gates, and post-launch checks. keep it <250 words.
rafa: also include a short line about incentives (credits/co-marketing) and expected time commitment. that helps commitment.
hana: agreed. suggested intake scoring keys: integration effort (1-4), data sensitivity (none/low/high), qps estimate, and willingness to share prompts/labels (Y/N).
liam: score mapping example: 
```
if score <=2 -> "light" pathway (2 wk)
if score 3-5 -> "beta" (4-6 wk)
if score >=6 -> "pilot/engagement" (spec + SLA)
```
noor: add a short "ship stop" checklist for devs: smoke test green, sample prompt set validated, docs quickstart updated, monitoring dashboard live.
rafa: we should create an "escrow" field: partner agrees to grant a limited prompt sample to run evals. if they can't, tag as "limited quality" and require more manual review.
hana: love "escrow" wording, concise. also add a single sentence NDA option link to sign if they want. keeps legal calls down. :white_check_mark: 
liam: metrics to collect at launch: human pass rate (sampled), hallucination flag rate, latency p95, cost/1k tokens, and a subjective CSAT after 14 days.
noor: for feedback cadence: 2 structured sessions (week 1 & week 4), plus an open channel for quick notes. require partners opt-in to at least week 1.
rafa: propose a lightweight "launch health" score combining metrics: 
```
health = round((pass_rate*0.5) + ((1-halluc_rate)*0.2) + ((baseline_latency/p95)*0.2) + (usage_factor*0.1), 2)
```
noor: keep formula internal, but share the interpretation: >0.8 = green, 0.6-0.8 = watch, <0.6 = rollback/patch.
hana: add rollback trigger: health <0.6 OR sudden cost delta >25% -> auto rollback to previous model alias + notify partner.
liam: operational items: intake form webhook -> scoring lambda -> creates tracker card with tags: "scoring, escrow-needed, on-prem". ops-bot can auto-assign to oncall PD.
ops-bot: note: will add rule: if data_sensitivity == "high" OR mentions "on-prem" -> tag security & legal and pause auto-assign.
rafa: recruitment copy (very short): 
"Hi {name}, thanks for your interest. Quick ask: short problem statement, expected qps, data residency, willingness to share 50-100 sample prompts, and preferred timeline. We'll reply in 48h and propose a path"
noor: include "expected time commitment" like: 2-4 hours total across calls + 1 pilot week for feedback. reduces no-shows.
hana: next steps: I'll draft the one-pager + intake form. liam can wire the lambda. noor will draft metrics & health calc. rafa will own the recruitment email + incentive language.
liam: ETA for MVP 8 business days? my rough: 3 for form + webhook, 2 for lambda, 2 for tracker glue, 1 for tests.
noor: i'll produce the sample prompt scaffold and a 10-item audit checklist for quality reviews.
hana: ops-bot, please nudge in 5 business days for status.
ops-bot: reminder set for 5 business days in #product.
rafa: once MVP done we run internal pilot with 2 DPs (sales-bot can route warm intros).
sales-bot: happy to surface 2 candidates this week. will DM names.
hana: awesome. goal: compress intake->decision to under 72h and reduce scope creep in pilot by 50%. we can iterate after first two DPs.
liam: :rocket:
